_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6)**_

The screenshots show it's working — you can see the session picker with **Local** and **Cloud** sessions. The agent selection (Claude vs Codex vs Copilot) appears when you **create a new session**, not from the existing sessions list.

To start a new session with Claude:

1. In that sessions list panel, look for a **"+"** or **"New Session"** button (top right of the panel)
2. Alternatively, look in the **Copilot title bar** (the icons at the top of the Copilot chat panel) — there should be an agent/session icon with a dropdown that lets you pick the agent

If you don't see a Claude/Codex option when creating a new session, double-check that the agents are toggled **On** in your repo-specific settings at [github.com/settings/copilot/coding_agent](https://github.com/settings/copilot/coding_agent) — the toggle must be enabled per-repository, not just globally.

I created a new chat session, but still don't see an agent type selector

_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6)**_

You're already fully set up — looking at your screenshots:

1. **Claude is already your active model** — Claude Sonnet 4.6 is selected (shown with a checkmark in the model picker)
2. **Both partner agents are On** in GitHub settings

The terminology is a bit confusing. There are two separate things:

| Feature | What it is | Where you control it |
|---|---|---|
| **Model picker** (Claude Sonnet 4.6) | Which LLM powers your local chat | The model dropdown you already found |
| **Partner agents** (Cloud agent) | Autonomous cloud tasks that open PRs | Switch from **Local → Cloud** at the bottom of the panel |

The **Partner Agents** toggle you enabled (Claude/Codex on GitHub settings) is for the **Cloud** mode — where you send a task and the agent works autonomously on GitHub, creating branches and PRs. To use that:

1. Click **"Local"** at the bottom-left of the chat panel → switch to **"Cloud"**
2. Type a task and submit — Claude will work on it on GitHub asynchronously

For normal interactive chat (what you're doing now), **Claude Sonnet 4.6 is already active** — you're good.
